arxiv-2111-06814.title: Acculturation and the evolution of cooperation in spatial public goods games
arxiv-2111-06814.creator: Alessandra F. Lütz, Marco A. Amaral, Lucas Wardil
arxiv-2111-06814.description: Abstract Cooperation is one of the foundations of human society. Many solutions to cooperation problems have been developed and culturally transmitted across generations. Because immigration can play a role in nourishing or disrupting cooperation in societies, we must understand how the newcomers’ culture interacts with the hosting culture.

arxiv-2206-08851.title: SMPL: Simulated Industrial Manufacturing and Process Control Learning Environments
arxiv-2206-08851.creator: Mohan Zhang, Xiaozhou Wang, Benjamin Decardi-Nelson, Song Bo, An Zhang, Jinfeng Liu, Sile Tao, Jiayi Cheng, Xiaohong Liu, DengDeng Yu, Matthew Poon, Animesh Garg
arxiv-2206-08851.description: Abstract Traditional biological and pharmaceutical manufacturing plants are controlled by human workers or pre-defined thresholds. Modernized factories have advanced process control algorithms such as model predictive control (MPC). However, there is little exploration of applying deep reinforcement learning to control manufacturing plants. One of the reasons is the lack of high fidelity simulations and standard APIs for benchmarking.

arxiv-2303-09957.title: A Benchmark of PDF Information Extraction Tools using a Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Evaluation Framework for Academic Documents
arxiv-2303-09957.creator: Norman Meuschke ,[ ORCID ], Apurva Jagdale, Timo Spinde ,[ ORCID ], Jelena Mitrović ,[ ORCID ], Bela Gipp ,[ ORCID ]
arxiv-2303-09957.description: Abstract Extracting information from academic PDF documents is crucial for numerous indexing, retrieval, and analysis use cases. Choosing the best tool to extract specific content elements is difficult because many, technically diverse tools are available, but recent performance benchmarks are rare.

arxiv-2304-10181.title: Heliknoton in a film of cubic chiral magnet
arxiv-2304-10181.creator: Vladyslav M. Kuchkin 1,2,3,∗ , Nikolai S. Kiselev 2,∗ , Filipp N. Rybakov 4 Igor S. Lobanov 5 , Stefan Blügel 2 , and Valery M. Uzdin 6
arxiv-2304-10181.description: Abstract 1 Cubic chiral magnets exhibit a remarkable diversity of two-dimensional topological magnetic textures, including skyrmions. However, the experimental confirmation of topological states localized in all three spatial dimensions remains challenging. In this paper, we investigate a three-dimensional topological state called a heliknoton, which is a hopfion embedded into a helix or conic background.

arxiv-2402-14016.title: Is LLM-as-a-Judge Robust? Investigating Universal Adversarial Attacks on Zero-shot LLM Assessment
arxiv-2402-14016.creator: Vyas RainaUniversity of Cambridge vr313@cam.ac.uk, Adian LiusieUniversity of Cambridge al826@cam.ac.uk Mark GalesUniversity of Cambridge mjfg@cam.ac.uk
arxiv-2402-14016.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vyas RainaUniversity of Cambridge vr313@cam.ac.uk, Adian LiusieUniversity of Cambridge al826@cam.ac.uk Mark GalesUniversity of Cambridge mjfg@cam.ac.uk. Large Language Models (LLMs) are powerful zero-shot assessors used in real-world situations such as assessing written exams and benchmarking systems. Despite these critical applications, no existing work has analyzed the vulnerability of judge-LLMs to adversarial manipulation. This work presents the first study on the adversarial robustness of assessment LLMs, where we demonstrate that short universal adversarial phrases can be concatenated to deceive judge LLMs to predict inflated scores.

arxiv-2404-05625.title: Robust Control using Control Lyapunov Function and Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability The work was supported by NSF grant 2128568
arxiv-2404-05625.creator: Chun-Ming Yang, Pranav A. Bhounsule
arxiv-2404-05625.description: Abstract The paper presents a robust control technique that combines the Control Lyapunov function and Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability to compute a controller and its Region of Attraction (ROA). The Control Lyapunov function uses a linear system model with an assumed additive uncertainty to calculate a control gain and the level sets of the ROA as a function of the uncertainty.

arxiv-2503-05472.title: Automatic determination of quasicrystalline patterns from microscopy images
arxiv-2503-05472.creator: Tano Kim Kender, Marco Corrias, Cesare Franchini
arxiv-2503-05472.description: Abstract Quasicrystals are aperiodically ordered solids that exhibit long-range order without translational periodicity, bridging the gap between crystalline and amorphous materials. Due to their lack of translational periodicity, information on atomic arrangements in quasicrystals cannot be extracted by current crystalline lattice recognition softwares.

arxiv-2503-17589.title: From Kinematic Motion Planners to Dynamic Autonomous Navigation with Obstacle Avoidance (Extended version)
arxiv-2503-17589.creator: Mayur Sawant, Abdelhamid Tayebi
arxiv-2503-17589.description: Abstract Kinematic motion planners are among the most widely used control approaches in robotic applications. By modeling the robot as a first-order system, they generate a feedback-based desired velocity field that guides the robot toward a target while avoiding obstacles.

arxiv-2508-07169.title: From Noise to Knowledge: Interactive Summaries for Developer Alerts
arxiv-2508-07169.creator: Burak Yetiştiren, Hong Jin Kang, Miryung Kim
arxiv-2508-07169.description: Abstract Programmers using bug-finding tools often review their reported warnings one by one. Based on the insight that identifying recurring themes and relationships can enhance the cognitive process of sensemaking , we propose CLARITY , which supports interpreting tool-generated warnings through interactive inquiry. CLARITY derives summary rules for custom grouping of related warnings with active feedback.

arxiv-2511-09701.title: Optimal control of Volterra integral diffusions and application to contract theory
arxiv-2511-09701.creator: Dylan Possamaï, Mehdi Talbi
arxiv-2511-09701.description: Abstract This paper focuses on the optimal control of a class of stochastic Volterra integral equations. Here the coefficients are regular and not assumed to be of convolution type. We show that, under mild regularity assumptions, these equations can be lifted in a Sobolev space, whose Hilbertian structure allows us to attack the problem through a dynamic programming approach.

pmc-12466422.title: Effects of Chronic Thermal Stress on the Physiology, Metabolism, Histology, and Gut Microbiota of Juvenile Schizothorax grahami
pmc-12466422.creator: Shuangqian Bai, Tingyin Li, Lingfu Kong, Baoliang Bi, Qing Hu, Pedro Miguel Guerreiro
pmc-12466422.description: Simple SummarySchizothorax grahami (Regan, 1904) is a representative species of Schizothoracine fish and has been classified as critically endangered (CR) by the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN). This cold-water species is native to Southwest China, with its distribution spanning the Yunnan–Guizhou Plateau and the Tibetan Plateau—both ecologically sensitive regions highly vulnerable to human activities and climate change.

pmc-12983594.title: Transcriptome profiling of intra-snail stages of the liver fluke Fasciola hepatica reveals key mediators underlying parasite development and interaction with the host
pmc-12983594.creator: Mauricio Langleib, Santiago Fontenla, Fernanda Domínguez, Geetha Sankaranarayanan, Sabina Wlodek, Matt Berriman, Gabriel Rinaldi, Andrés Iriarte, José F Tort
pmc-12983594.description: BackgroundWhile mammalian host invasion by the liver fluke Fasciola hepatica has been extensively studied, reports on the interaction with its intermediate host at the molecular level remain scarce. These developmental stages are particularly interesting since at least two cycles of asexual amplification occur within lymnaeid snails, leading to the production of hundreds of infective metacercariae.

pmc-13403574.title: Midbrain hypoactivation and mesocortical hypoconnectivity in inhibitory control learning in autism
pmc-13403574.creator: Ana Araújo, Isabel C Duarte, Teresa Sousa, Graça Areias, Ana T Pereira, Trevor W Robbins, António Macedo, Miguel Castelo-Branco
pmc-13403574.description: Repetitive behaviour, resulting from impaired inhibitory control and error monitoring, represents a core manifestation of autism, with a poorly understood neural basis. Our primary hypothesis was that a striatum-midbrain framework could provide a theoretical basis for understanding neural changes underlying response inhibition in autism.

pmc-13591699.title: Disaster nursing competencies and psychological resilience among registered nurses in post-pandemic Saudi arabia: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13591699.creator: Fathia Ahmed Mersal, Bander Saad Albagawi, Rasmia Abd El Sattar Ali, Zakaria Ahmed Mani, Radhi Krim Alshammari, Jaber Ali Nami, Atallah Alenezi, Salman Hamdan Alsaqri
pmc-13591699.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundDisaster nursing refers to the knowledge, skills, and professional judgement required to prevent, prepare for, respond to, and recover from disaster events. Psychological resilience refers to the capacity to adapt to adversity while maintaining professional functioning. In Saudi Arabia, post-pandemic evaluation of these capacities is particularly relevant because nurses practise in a setting shaped by mass gatherings, emerging infectious disease threats, and ongoing emergency preparedness demands.
